text: The fourth form of Navadurga: Sri Kushmanda Devi
Did you know that this entire universe was born from just a gentle smile of the Goddess?
The fourth form among the Navadurgas is Sri Kushmanda Devi.
According to scriptural tradition, before creation came into being, darkness enveloped everywhere.
It is said that the Goddess then created the universe with her gentle smile.
That is why Kushmanda Devi is worshipped as the primordial energy, the source of creation.
There is another special aspect to the Goddess's form.
That is why she is also known as Ashtabhuja Devi.
Appearing mounted on a lion, the Goddess holds a kamandalam, bow, arrow, lotus, chakra, mace, pot of nectar, and a rosary in her hands.
Tradition also says that she holds a special connection with the solar sphere (Suryamandala).
The power responsible for the birth of this entire universe… has been depicted through a single gentle smile!
The form that reminds us of the primal power of creation, light, and life… is Sri Kushmanda Devi.
